    Special successors in Iyama left ladders #

    This file proves the categorical dual of Iyama, Tau-categories I, 3.6.1(2)(ii). A special split-epimorphic cofactor through the first map of a left tau-sequence has a special complementary successor through the second map. No concrete algebra or module classification is used.
